question: What conduct should a practitioner with equanimous mind abandon through practice?
premises: Practice leads to an equanimous mind
Certain social duties are contrasted with this state
The practitioner is instructed to abandon village dharma
inference: Through practice, one who has attained equanimity of mind should abandon village dharma.
uncertainties: grāma-dharmañ may refer to conventional social or household duties
plain_english: Through practice, becoming even-minded, one should abandon the dharma of village life.
